name: Sea Gate
description: Sea Gate is the largest and most developed city on Tazeem, built atop the dam forming Halimar, and also the name of an expeditionary house founded there.

bio.text: In the Battle for Zendikar, Sea Gate was overrun by the Eldrazi, and Gideon arrived too late to prevent the massacre but led survivors to safety.

citations.text: Gruesome Slaughter (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
Courier Griffin (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Gideon gathered allies including Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces, and the army retook the city from the Eldrazi.

citations.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At Sea Gate, Gideon, Jace and Nissa trapped Ulamog in a ring of hedrons, and the Gatewatch later formed on cliffs overlooking the city.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.
"Sea Gate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Ob Nixilis knocked the hedrons out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and calling Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, and Kozilek destroyed Sea Gate.

citations.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.
"Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.
Tears of Valakut (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: After the titans were destroyed near Sea Gate, Commander Tazri drafted a rebuilding plan backed by Linvala and the city was restored within a year.

citations.text: "Zendikar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Tazri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Adventurers who explored a Skyclave founded the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, funded by a secret benefactor who was Nahiri.

citations.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "Aftermath and impact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Kesenya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Tazri led Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians, and the city fell again as Linvala carried Tazri away.

timeline.summary: A minotaur kicks down the protagonist's study door to report a dragon.
timeline.quote: "There's a ... dragon," he manages.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The dragon attacks Sea Gate with a column of caustic fire.
timeline.quote: A column of caustic fire rains down on you.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The protagonist blasts a hole in the dragon's wing; it flees and buildings burn.
timeline.quote: Your blast of electrical mayhem tore a nasty hole right through the dragon's wing membrane.

citation.text: "Booster Quest: The Shaman's Orb". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Posing as Kejahar, Anowon infiltrates the scholars of the Lighthouse in Sea Gate and links the Eye of Ugin to the secret past of vampires.
timeline.quote: Anowon made a connection between the Eye of Ugin and the secret past of the vampires that Tenihas had so carefully protected.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "The Infiltration of Sea Gate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A kor woman who knew Anowon is found dead, and the militia uncover his vampire nature.
timeline.quote: they uncovered his hidden nature as a vampire.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "The Infiltration of Sea Gate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The enraged townspeople beat Anowon nearly to death and cast him into the Halimar, but he survives.
timeline.quote: They then cast his broken body over the seawall and into the waters of the Halimar far below.

citation.text: "Anowon", section "The Infiltration of Sea Gate". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate and the Enclave fall to the Eldrazi spawn and Noyan Dar leads refugees upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge.
timeline.quote: he led refugees from the Enclave farther upriver to found Coralhelm Refuge

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Noyan Dar and his students take part in the Liberation of Sea Gate and drive off Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: helped in driving off Ulamog 's brood

citation.text: "Noyan Dar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Within two years of the Eldrazi's release, Sea Gate is overrun and destroyed, Oran-Rief dies and Halimar is emptied.
timeline.quote: Within two years of the release of the Eldrazi, Sea Gate was overrun and destroyed.

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is formed on a cliffside overlooking Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: The formation of the Gatewatch occurred on Tazeem

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Rise of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog's brood causes the Slaughter at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Its brood caused the Slaughter at Sea Gate

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Release". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Munda tells Gideon a great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: "A great host of Eldrazi descends on Sea Gate."

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi overwhelm Sea Gate and pin Gideon under a beam until he frees himself.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi swept in from both sides of the sea wall.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon meets the merfolk Jori En carrying her dead companion Kendrin, who had been on the brink of a discovery about leylines and the Eye.
timeline.quote: Kendrin was on the brink of a discovery.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon concludes Sea Gate is lost and that Kendrin's leylines puzzle is a possible answer, and he needs another expert.
timeline.quote: Fighting to avoid something was not the same as fighting for something.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon rides an Eldrazi off the sea wall into the sea, then planeswalks to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: In a tangle of tendrils, Gideon fell with it.

citation.text: "Limits" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon tells Jace Sea Gate has fallen and asks him to solve the puzzle of leylines.
timeline.quote: "Sea Gate has fallen."

citation.text: "Catching Up" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes in silence, unable to feel Zendikar or Ashaya, and stumbles toward a sea of Eldrazi at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But there was nothing there to grasp.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A wounded merfolk saves Nissa from walking into an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: It was a merfolk, one clad in thick, sharp armor made of seashells.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa carries Jori En and fights with her sword, but without Zendikar's help she is pinned by an Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: She pulled on her arm with her all, but the tentacle was too heavy.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Kor on a floating rock rescue Nissa and Jori with hooked ropes.
timeline.quote: The next moment the tentacle was pulled off of her

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: A huge Eldrazi lands on the rock and Gideon appears, lashing it away with his sural and hauling everyone up.
timeline.quote: four glowing, white whips fly through the air and lash into the Eldrazi's side.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jori reunite, and he leads the survivors across floating rocks to a nearby encampment.
timeline.quote: "Jori En!" The Planeswalker cried out

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa tells Gideon her connection to Zendikar was ripped away, but Gideon says his power is unchanged.
timeline.quote: "Mine is gone. It was ripped away.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon is welcomed at the encampment with the rescued survivors while Nissa reaches out and finds Zendikar silent and empty.
timeline.quote: Zendikar was empty.

citation.text: "The Silent Cry" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Aug 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre but leads survivors to safety.
timeline.quote: Though Gideon arrived at Sea Gate too late to prevent the massacre, he still had enough time to lead its survivors to relative safety.

citation.text: Gruesome Slaughter (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate falls and survivors flee.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate has fallen. Survivors are on the move.

citation.text: Courier Griffin (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Everyone who could lift a weapon takes part in retaking Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Everyone who could still lift a weapon had a part in retaking Sea Gate.

citation.text: Outnumber (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace and Jori En go to the Eye, where Ugin is rebuilding the network; Jace sees the hedrons could be used to kill the Eldrazi and leaves despite Ugin's warnings.
timeline.quote: Ignoring Ugin's dire warnings, Jace left the Eye

citation.text: "Eye of Ugin", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon's army, joined by Kiora and Nissa, retakes Sea Gate and Ulamog is trapped with hedrons.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi were driven from the city

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jace activates the hedrons and traps Ulamog.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kiora arrives with merfolk and sea monster reinforcements for the Liberation of Sea Gate, meets Gideon, and they retake the city together.
timeline.quote: After 2 more days of fighting, they had retaken Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri falls on bad times and joins the Sea Gate militia, where Vorik sees her potential.
timeline.quote: She immediately caught the interest of militia captain Vorik

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Earlier years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate is overtaken by the Eldrazi; Tazri meets Gideon Jura at a refugee camp.
timeline.quote: She first met Gideon Jura in a refugee camp outside the city, after a battle with Ulamog's spawn.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri joins Gideon, Drana and Munda to retake Sea Gate; a failure kills many Zendikari but Sea Gate is reclaimed after training.
timeline.quote: Despite her worries, Sea Gate was reclaimed after intensive training

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En warns that Ulamog is approaching Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was approaching Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri meets Nissa and Kiora and urges evacuation while Gideon, Drana and Kiora plan to fight the titan; Jace proposes trapping Ulamog with the hedron network.
timeline.quote: saying Ulamog could be trapped using an aligned hedron network.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ulamog is trapped, but Ob Nixilis disrupts the network, freeing Ulamog and waking Kozilek.
timeline.quote: the demon planeswalker Ob Nixilis appeared and disrupted the network, leaving Ulamog to ravage the city and waking Kozilek as well.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saved by her halo, Tazri regroups with Noyan Dar, Drana and Munda and takes command, leading to Chandra's arrival.
timeline.quote: inspired by the angel she had killed so long ago, took command.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa and Kiora retakes Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.
timeline.quote: The Zendikar resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa, and Kiora assaulted and retook Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon wrestles Ulamog while Nissa unearths hedrons and Jace triggers them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace then triggered them, activating their latent magic and knocking the titan off balance while trapping him.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis knocks the hedrons out of alignment and reignites his spark.
timeline.quote: Everything looked to be smooth sailing until Ob Nixilis arrived, knocked the hedrons out of alignment, and positioned himself between them.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kozilek arrives and rebuffs Gideon's army.
timeline.quote: they were rebuffed by the arrival of a second titan: Kozilek

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "Aligned hedron network". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch binds both titans in leylines and Chandra burns them, ending Ulamog's material manifestation on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Ulamog on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The death of Ulamog". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Within two years Sea Gate, Sejiri and Bala Ged are overrun in the Battle for Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Sea Gate on Tazeem and the entire continents of Sejiri and Bala Ged were overrun

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon takes command and gathers allies including Malakir vampires, Noyan Dar Roil-mages and Kiora's merfolk army to retake Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon Jura took command, and started gathering allies to take the offensive.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are driven from Sea Gate, then Jori En arrives with news that Ulamog is approaching.
timeline.quote: Then, Jori En arrived with the news that Ulamog himself was approaching ....

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nissa raises hedrons around Ulamog and Jace activates them, trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: Jace activated the hedrons' magic, and Ulamog was trapped!

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis slaughters the Kor guards, siphons the hedrons' power to reignite his spark, destroys the network and awakens Kozilek.
timeline.quote: he destroyed the hedron network and awoke the slumbering Eldrazi titan Kozilek .

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gideon leads a headlong charge against Eldrazi spawn and larger Eldrazi near Sea Gate, while many soldiers die.
timeline.quote: The spawn fell quickly under the initial charge

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon recalls losing his Irregulars on Theros and fears he is again leading people to their deaths.
timeline.quote: So many of the Zendikari were dying.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Cut off from his army, Gideon joins Munda, who tells him the army cannot win that day.
timeline.quote: "We're not going to win this," Munda said. "Not today."

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders a retreat, which turns into a rout as the army dissolves, leaving Gideon, Munda and a few soldiers to hold off the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: The ordered retreat turned into a rout.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri sounds a horn to rally the survivors, and the army regroups at camp as the sun sets.
timeline.quote: As the sun touched the horizon, the army of Zendikar was coming back together.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri tells Gideon the battle was a disaster because he led from the front and gave his army no plan or strategy.
timeline.quote: They need to know how they fit into the army and the overall plan of attack.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon realizes he has failed his commanders as well as his army and takes Tazri and Munda to work out a plan.
timeline.quote: "Walk with me, Tazri," he said.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Over several days Gideon meets with the commanders and builds a plan that gives every contingent a role.
timeline.quote: Over the next few days, a plan came together.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The army marches again in organized ranks to the beat of a conch-shell drum, with Noyan Dar's roilmages held back.
timeline.quote: They marched.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: A scout reports a fleet of sea monsters swimming toward Sea Gate and leaving Eldrazi remains behind them, and Gideon takes them for allies.
timeline.quote: "Allies, then," Gideon said. "At least for now."

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: At dusk the army retreats in a planned maneuver and Drana's vampires take the front ranks, fighting through the night.
timeline.quote: But the maneuver went off without incident.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora appears on the tentacle of an enormous octopus and introduces herself, claiming command of her own army and the city.
timeline.quote: "I am Kiora," the merfolk said.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora summons a wave and her sea creatures tear into the Eldrazi, announcing the battle of Sea Gate has begun.
timeline.quote: The ocean churned as sharks and whales, serpents and krakens, tore into the Eldrazi.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: On the fourth day the army reaches the outer wall and then surges through it into Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the army of Zendikar surged through the wall and entered Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: In the streets of the city the army's elves, goblins, kitesailers and eel-riders each play their role against the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: That meant it was time to let other forces do what they did best.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Elementals of tree and stone march through Sea Gate crushing the Eldrazi, and Gideon sees that Nissa has returned bringing Zendikar with her.
timeline.quote: Nissa had returned. And she had indeed brought Zendikar with her.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: The tide turns, and the Zendikari drive the Eldrazi out of the city.
timeline.quote: And the Zendikari had the upper hand. They were going to win!

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Fighting stops and Gideon sees from the lighthouse that the army has reclaimed Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: But Sea Gate was theirs.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Nissa and Kiora gather in the lighthouse, and Jori En bursts in to warn that Ulamog is coming.
timeline.quote: "Ulamog is coming!"

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora climbs the lighthouse and enters Gideon's meeting of advisors uninvited.
timeline.quote: Her lack of invitation was clearly an oversight. She marched in.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En bursts in with news that Ulamog is coming and that Jace delayed her return so she could warn them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog is coming!

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Tazri argues for evacuation while Drana, Nissa and Kiora argue for an assault.
timeline.quote: An assault is the only reason I'm here,

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora volunteers to lead the offensive and demonstrates the bident by sending a wave through the window.
timeline.quote: Only the most powerful artifact on all of Zendikar

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, after a moment alone, orders that they will not evacuate but stay, fight and kill the titan.
timeline.quote: We do not evacuate. We stay and we fight. And we kill the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon assigns Nissa to lead land forces and Kiora to coordinate a sea attack.
timeline.quote: you will coordinate a sea attack.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ebi brings Jace to the lighthouse, and Gideon embraces his friend.
timeline.quote: Gideon closed the distance and embraced the smaller man

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace pitches the hedron trap, but Kiora insists on attacking with the bident and Nissa objects to trapping the titan.
timeline.quote: One hedron alone isn't enough

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that a failed assault could drive Ulamog onto another world, but Kiora strikes at him with the bident and leaves on a tentacle; Gideon deflects the blow.
timeline.quote: Gideon was deflecting the strike of Kiora's bident meant for Jace.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon orders the army to build the trap and assigns commanders to patrols, telling them to keep Kiora from interfering.
timeline.quote: We will build the trap, and once we have secured our target, we will launch our offensive as planned.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Through the night Nissa and Ashaya dig up hedrons and the kor and Zendikari teams hoist them into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: They pulled and tightened their ropes in opposite directions, slowing the hedron to a gentle stop.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At dawn Seble sees Ulamog approaching, and Nissa restrains the urge to attack it alone.
timeline.quote: And that's when she saw the titan.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon stands alone before Ulamog while Jace rehearses the trap with illusions, and Ulamog lurches into the ring.
timeline.quote: as Ulamog lurched through.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: The ring fails to light because of a misaligned hedron.
timeline.quote: The ring didn't flare to life like it was supposed to.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa shares Jace's mind and illusion, and they locate the tilted hedron; Nissa leaps to it.
timeline.quote: The hedron was tilted; it must have shifted sometime after being carefully locked into place.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, nearly overwhelmed by Ulamog, holds out until a blue flash lifts the pressure and the titan is pulled into the glowing prison.
timeline.quote: Ulamog had been pulled within the bounds of the hedron prison

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: The Zendikari cheer that Ulamog is trapped.
timeline.quote: They had done it. Ulamog was trapped.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: A demon lands before the sentry Ebi, strangles him and leaves him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Take what solace you can in the knowledge that you will not be here to witness Zendikar's demise.

citation.text: "Hedron Alignment" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: At Sea Gate he sees Ulamog trapped in an enormous hedron network.
timeline.quote: Armies clashing, spawn and Zendikari slaughtered by the thousands, and rising above it all, Ulamog. Trapped.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He flies above the battle and locks his keystone hedron above the ring's center, tapping the network's energy.
timeline.quote: I willed it into place, locked it into a harmonic point above the ring's precise center.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis's spark returns and he feels the Multiverse again.
timeline.quote: My spark returned.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He knocks a structural hedron out of alignment, freeing Ulamog and collapsing the network, and Nissa sees him.
timeline.quote: A snap of my fingers, and one of the structural hedrons fell out of alignment.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: He unleashes a bolt of annihilation on the armies, cutting off their retreat and forcing them toward Ulamog.
timeline.quote: I let loose an enormous bolt of withering annihilation into the armies below

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis reaches out to an awakening power deep beneath the surface to the south and calls it to rise.
timeline.quote: Awakened it fully with the sheer force of my will.

citation.text: "At Any Cost" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra watches Gideon direct the placement of a hedron into the ring over the water.
timeline.quote: One of the larger hedrons, hovering over the water, was moving .

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives at Sea Gate and finds Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring while Zendikari cheer.
timeline.quote: Ulamog was trapped.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: A winged demon draws power from the hedron prison, causing the hedrons to fall and freeing Ulamog.
timeline.quote: The circle was breaking.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra fails to hurt the demon or the titan, and a second Eldrazi titan rises from the ground.
timeline.quote: A second Eldrazi titan had entered the battle.

citation.text: "Promises to Keep" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Jace find Sea Gate overrun and hold off the Eldrazi so survivors can flee.
timeline.quote: the two were able to hold off the Eldrazi to allow survivors to flee to safety.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa loses her connection to Zendikar's soul and agrees to meet the others outside Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: But her connection to Zendikar's elemental soul had suddenly vanished

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers Drana, Noyan Dar, Tazri, Nissa and Kiora's forces and retakes Sea Gate from the Eldrazi.
timeline.quote: Together, their combined forces managed to wrest Sea Gate away from the Eldrazi invaders.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Jori En returns with the news that Ulamog is headed toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: the Eldrazi titan Ulamog himself was headed towards Sea Gate.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Jace and Nissa trap Ulamog in a ring of hedrons at Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Gideon lured the titan into the center of the ring while the other two activated the network, imprisoning Ulamog.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis arrives and knocks the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his spark.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis knocked the hedrons out of alignment to siphon their energy and reignite his Planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Chandra leaves Keral Keep for Zendikar and finds Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.
timeline.quote: she left the Keep for Zendikar...only to find Ob Nixilis disrupting the hedron network.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Gideon attacks the trapped Ulamog, but Ob Nixilis calls Kozilek from beneath Zendikar, leaving two titans rampaging.
timeline.quote: Ob Nixilis had called Kozilek, one of the other Eldrazi titans, from beneath Zendikar's surface.

citation.text: "Battle for Zendikar Story Summary" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora descends from Sea Gate on an octopus tentacle to rejoin her own army of tricksters and sea monsters after the other planeswalkers dismiss her.
timeline.quote: five of Cosi's own tricksters and a legion of sea monsters.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tells the tricksters Ulamog is coming and that the other planeswalkers plan to trap him, while she plans to kill or drive him away.
timeline.quote: Our plan is to kill him if we can, and drive him off if we can't,

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora leaves three tricksters at Sea Gate and swims out to open water with Shen, Yesha and half her armada.
timeline.quote: Kiora turned and swam away from Sea Gate, out into the open ocean.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Riding Lorthos, Kiora and the tricksters converge on Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Slowly but inexorably, Lorthos and Ula converged on Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora sees Ulamog trapped in the hedron ring, then the hedrons fall and he is freed.
timeline.quote: Whatever the cause, the effect was clear: Ula was free of his prison.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises from the bay and rips open the sea wall, letting the Halimar Sea pour through.
timeline.quote: Another and he stood before Sea Gate.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes Cosi always won and that she has been tricked, as Kozilek turns toward her.
timeline.quote: Cosi always won.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek takes control of Shen, who lunges at Kiora, and she kills him with the bident.
timeline.quote: She raised the bident, and its twin points buried themselves in Shen's chest.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kozilek cleaves Lorthos in two, and Kiora falls into the water and drops the bident.
timeline.quote: Lorthos's body shuddered and split

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora realizes Kozilek never saw her and that she has killed her followers, then loses consciousness.
timeline.quote: She hit the water, and blackness claimed her.

citation.text: "The Rise of Kozilek" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Dec 2015.

timeline.summary: Nissa heaves the last hedron into place, trapping Ulamog, and prepares to destroy him while Jace outlines a plan.
timeline.quote: Nissa had heaved the last hedron into place , trapping Ulamog, the monster that had ravaged her world.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa calls on Ashaya, but Ashaya cracks and crumbles and the world shakes.
timeline.quote: Then something broke.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The seawall heaves, the hedron ring shakes, and a stray hedron with dark power breaks a leyline.
timeline.quote: The circle was broken.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to complete the broken circle with her own body but is struck down by Ulamog's tentacle.
timeline.quote: Nissa only saw the thick, pink tentacle after it had struck her.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The rest of the ring collapses and Ulamog, free again, moves toward Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Ulamog, free of his bonds, was moving toward Sea Gate once more.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa recognizes the demon from Bala Ged as the cause of the collapse as he casts a great spell.
timeline.quote: He was the cause of all of this.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis calls a second titan, Kozilek, up from the ground.
timeline.quote: The demon had called yet another horror to ravage her world.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa surrenders to rage and runs at the demon through Kozilek's distortion and the toppling lighthouse.
timeline.quote: Kozilek's flailing arm had smashed into the seawall

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa tackles Ob Nixilis with her blade at his neck, but he escapes and drains her with essence magic.
timeline.quote: sending a tide of his essence-draining magic down at Nissa.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis uses spawn of Kozilek to cut Nissa off from Zendikar and the leylines.
timeline.quote: She was cut off from Zendikar. Powerless.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis senses a telepath in his head and strikes down Jace, breaking his cheekbone.
timeline.quote: my fist broke his cheekbone instead of taking his head off as I'd intended.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon tears Ob Nixilis's wing and confronts him, declaring the people under his protection.
timeline.quote: These people are under my protection, demon.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Ob Nixilis fight, and Ob Nixilis breaks the telepath's confidence in Gideon and kills six stragglers.
timeline.quote: Six dead.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon breaks Ob Nixilis's knee with a joint lock, but the demon pins him.
timeline.quote: The knee cracked and a sickening jolt pulsed through my body.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Ob Nixilis drowns Gideon in muddy water, and Gideon's body goes limp.
timeline.quote: Invulnerability proved no match for three inches of dirty water.

citation.text: "Retaliation of Ob Nixilis" by Kimberly J. Kreines, Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Kozilek rises, Ulamog is freed, and Tazri rallies her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate.
timeline.quote: Tazri rallied her soldiers away from the collapsing Sea Gate

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: A shimmering wave from Kozilek crashes over the fleeing army, killing Romoe, Magain and Debins horribly.
timeline.quote: Time slowed. Insanity blossomed.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: The wave hits Tazri and her angel's halo glows as her past and future flicker through her mind.
timeline.quote: Time, previously slowed, now stretched .

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: years later, fired by caravan merchants and unable to dream, Tazri asks Vorik for a militia job and he hires her.
timeline.quote: I could use a fighter like you.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Vorik, dying, names Gideon Jura his successor, and Tazri feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: when I am gone, you will lead these people.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri returns to find her soldiers dead and Kozilek far away, and sees Noyan Dar's roilmages obliterated by reflected fire and earth.
timeline.quote: Tazri didn't have time to shout a warning as the fire and earth swept through the roilmages, obliterating them.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Drana rescues Noyan Dar in mid-air, and Drana's and Munda's troops turn the tide briefly.
timeline.quote: The arrival of Drana's and Munda's troops had temporarily turned the tide of battle.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri assumes command, tells Noyan Dar to open a rift and orders Munda to prepare the troops to flee, leaving the dying behind.
timeline.quote: Munda, prepare the troops. We are getting out of here.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri persuades Drana to follow her as general and to feed energy to Noyan Dar.
timeline.quote: As you command, General Tazri,

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Tazri decides the battle for Zendikar is just beginning.
timeline.quote: The battle for Zendikar was now truly beginning.

citation.work: The Blight We Were Born For
citation.text: "The Blight We Were Born For" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2016.

timeline.summary: Kozilek emerges at Sea Gate and his brood swarms to the surface.
timeline.quote: When Kozilek emerged at Sea Gate, his brood lineage swarmed to the surface.

citation.text: Essence Depleter (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kozilek destroys Sea Gate and Valakut grieves.
timeline.quote: When Kozilek destroyed Sea Gate, distant Valakut could not contain its grief.

citation.text: Tears of Valakut (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ulamog stands ready to succumb at Sea Gate, then Kozilek arises.
timeline.quote: Ulamog stood before us at Sea Gate, ready to succumb . . . and then Kozilek arose.

citation.text: Witness the End (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sea Gate falls and the Halimar basin is drained.
timeline.quote: After the fall of Sea Gate and the draining of the Halimar basin, the crab set off to find a new home.

citation.text: Ancient Crab (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oath near ruins of Sea Gate is witnessed.
timeline.quote: Before the battle, I heard them take an oath near the ruins of Sea Gate.

citation.text: Joraga Auxiliary (Oath of the Gatewatch, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace and Nissa imprison Ulamog in a hedron network at Sea Gate on Ugin's advice, but Ob Nixilis's interference makes it fail and he calls Kozilek to join Ulamog.
timeline.quote: That effort was briefly successful but ultimately failed due to interference by Ob Nixilis

citation.text: "Destruction of Ulamog and Kozilek", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kozilek slices Lorthos in half and turns on Kiora, who is left wounded.
timeline.quote: the titan destroyed Lorthos by slicing it in half using its arm blades

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Zendikar's Last Stand". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jori En wakes in the murky water beneath Sea Gate amid the carcasses of the sea's creatures, including a dead horned rift octopus.
timeline.quote: And it was dead.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori breaks the surface and sees Sea Gate toppled and eroded by Kozilek's blight, remembering that Ulamog was freed and Kozilek rose.
timeline.quote: The hedron network had failed. Ulamog was free.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori hears a cry for help and finds Kiora with a compound leg fracture, who says Cosi won and the bident is gone.
timeline.quote: Cosi won,

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jori sets and splints Kiora's leg, and green energy heals the wound.
timeline.quote: a cluster of green motes fluttered to life around the wound.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Kiora asks Jori's help to recover the bident, which she calls their only hope, and Jori agrees to show her the way.
timeline.quote: Now we just need to recover the bident.

citation.text: "Beneath the Surface" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: From the mountains Gideon sees the ruin of Sea Gate and the two titans creeping across the land, and realizes his army is gone.
timeline.quote: His army was gone.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura vows that though Sea Gate has fallen they still stand and fight.
timeline.quote: "Sea Gate may have fallen, but we still stand.

citation.text: Shoulder to Shoulder (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akiri remembers the Battle at Sea Gate and how inexperienced Zareth was when pressed into her unit.
timeline.quote: He had been pressed into the liberation of Sea Gate because he could hold a spear

citation.text: "Red Route" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives in Sea Gate, aware she cannot reach the Murasa Skyclave alone after relying on Nissa in Akoum.
timeline.quote: she could not visit the Murasa Skyclave alone and hope to survive

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri meets Expeditionary House head Kesenya, who calls her Benefactor, and asks for a brave team.
timeline.quote: And now I need a brave and capable team to retrieve something very precious and very powerful.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri pitches Akiri's party on retrieving the Lithoform Core from a Murasa Skyclave, claiming it will heal Zendikar.
timeline.quote: The object I seek will heal Zendikar of all its scars.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Nahiri shows the key, and Zareth proposes a card game of Conquest.
timeline.quote: Adventuring parties like to call this little game Conquest .

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: During the game Zareth picks Nahiri's pocket for the key; she turns the cards to granite and demands it back.
timeline.quote: Then she snapped her fingers and turned all the cards to granite.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Akiri's party agrees to depart at first light.
timeline.quote: When do we head out?

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Zareth confides to Kesenya that he fears what the Core will do and asks her to find a buyer, planning to steal it.
timeline.quote: All I'm asking you to do is find a buyer for the Core who is rich and stupid.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives in Sea Gate looking for Nissa and meets Mara at the memorial.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked to the massive platform with its six upright hedrons.

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: Jace discloses the situation to Kesenya, who refuses help but secretly writes Murasa on a note.
timeline.quote: But scrawled on the bottom of the parchment, there was a single word: Murasa .

citation.work: Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave
citation.text: "Episode 2: Race to the Murasa Skyclave" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2020.

timeline.summary: The adventurers retrieve relics and found the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, inspiring new expeditions.
timeline.quote: became the founding members of the newly founded Sea Gate Expeditionary House

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "Aftermath and impact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Eldrazi fall, Commander Tazri drafts a rebuilding plan backed by Linvala and Sea Gate is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The adventurers who breached Emeria form the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, secretly backed by Nahiri.
timeline.quote: the house's benefactor is Nahiri

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fed up with the expeditionary houses' infighting, Tazri drafts her own plan for Sea Gate, which Linvala backs, and the city is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Fed up with the houses' infighting, Tazri drafted a plan of her own.

citation.text: "Tazri", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri drafts her own rebuilding plan for Sea Gate, backed by the angel Linvala, and the city is restored within a year.
timeline.quote: Within a year, the city was restored.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nundari describes the militia training for improbable events.
timeline.quote: We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once.

citation.text: Chain Reaction (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
timeline.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"
